market_view: Calm regime: VIX 16.5 and falling, cooler CPI helped the S&P 500 on 07-14. Oil rebounded sharply (WTI +12.6% in 5 days) and chips bounced; no headline names a leader-specific catalyst.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI +12.6% in 5 days is a driver move that already happened. No XOM or OPEC+ headline; the oil_gas-tagged items are unrelated general news.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold +1.6% on 07-14 is priced in; gold is still 23% below its high and below its 200-day average. No NEM headline.

chips.reasoning: NVDA headlines are opinion pieces (Motley Fool lists, SK Hynix HBM share). IBM's capex-shift warning is not a chip catalyst. NVDA +4% on 07-14 is priced in.

pharma.reasoning: No LLY-specific news; only a market-size press release and a Fool ETF piece. LLY -6.7% over 5 days with the sector down; no cause visible.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper +1.6% and FCX +3.3% are already priced. No supply or China demand headline for copper or uranium.

would_change_my_mind: A leader-specific headline: OPEC+ or supply shock, NEM guidance, an NVDA export-rule change or guidance raise, an LLY trial or regulator decision, or a copper mine outage.

handoff.what_changed: Five days since the last note (07-10). WTI jumped 12.6% over 5 days to 79.3 and the semiconductor ETF bounced (+2.5% on 07-14). LLY fell 6.7% over 5 days with the health care ETF down. Headlines again held no leader-specific catalyst.

oil_gas.why: WTI rebound already priced; no XOM or OPEC+ headline.

gold_miners.why: Gold bounce priced in; no NEM-specific catalyst.

chips.why: Only opinion headlines on NVDA; NVDA +4% on 07-14 already priced.

pharma.why: No LLY news; the 5-day drop has no visible cause.

copper_uranium.why: Copper and FCX bounce priced in; no supply or demand headline.
